LanguageData.RHA_V19_Desc0: Tracks a colonist for 2 seconds, then locks its position for 3 seconds before striking. Move out or interrupt the caster.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_Desc1: Marks a 3-cell-wide beam and fires after 4 seconds. Step sideways or interrupt the caster.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_Desc2: Marks a 4-cell-radius blast and charges for 4 seconds. Leave the area or interrupt the caster.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_Desc3: A prism with 180 hit points boosts trial enemies within 10 cells by 25% damage. Destroy it to remove the boost.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_Desc4: Marks a rift beneath a colonist. After 4 seconds it pulses three times, 2 seconds apart. Leave its 3-cell radius.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_Desc5: The caster marks reinforcements arriving in 4 seconds. Each cast calls 2 temporary enemies; at most 6 per wave, lasting 20 seconds. Interruptible.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_Off: Variants were disabled for this run.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_Payout: Claimable / claimed rewards:\nBase: {0} shards, {1} cores, {2} essence\nExtra risk: {3} shards, {4} cores
LanguageData.RHA_V19_LegacyReport: This older trial has no duration or path-certification snapshot. Its original rewards and contributions remain.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_Running: Trial in progress. Certification results are saved when it ends.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_GoalState: Sources at finish: {0}; waves with a path-ability cast: {1}
LanguageData.RHA_V19_NoGoal: No path challenge was tracked at trial start.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_PracticeGoal: The path was still in foundation or practice at start; this run cannot certify it.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_GoalChanged: The tracked challenge changed, was abandoned, or its assigned participant is missing.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_GoalRules: Requires a tier 3+ standard trial, challenge rules enabled and at least 100% intensity.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_GoalStart: Not registered at start. Track certification beforehand and meet build/presence requirements; colony paths also need their preparation cast.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_GoalBuild: The build did not satisfy 5 distinct sources and a base evolution at completion.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_GoalOwner: At completion, the participant must be a free colonist, alive, standing and on the trial map.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_GoalWaves: The assigned colonist did not cast the path ability in each of the three waves.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_GoalIncomplete: All three waves were not completed.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_GoalPassed: Path certified. Claim its milestone in Path challenges; replays only update records.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_Contributions: Contributions: damage includes direct and secondary hits. Healing and shields cover effects recorded by this mod, not all vanilla treatment or other mods.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_StartHint: This run includes one variant. Optionally add a second between waves. Area-strike variants are never combined. Map warnings show incoming attacks; down or stun the caster to cancel.
LanguageData.RHA_V19_RiskHint: Continue without extra risk, or add a variant for the next wave. Clearing it earns {0} extra shards and 1 core, at most twice per run.
